title: implied bounds from impl header are not used in associated functions/consts
body:
The following fails to compile although it shouldn't: https://play.rust-lang.org/?version=stable&mode=debug&edition=2021&gist=f7287b6897a385360f7190001b58348d ```rust /// A type with an implied bound `'b: 'a` struct Ty<'a, 'b>(&'a &'b ()); impl<'a, 'b> Ty<'a, 'b> // <- tait or inherent impl where //'b: 'a, // <- fixed by an explicit bound { fn f() { // <- no `Self` in signature Self; //~^ ERROR lifetime bound not satisfied // Cannot prove WF of `Self` because `'b: 'a` is not known to hold } } ``` Another repro: ```rust struct Ty<'a, 'b>(&'a &'b ()); impl<'a, 'b> Ty<'a, 'b>{ fn f() { None::<&'a &'b ()>; //~^ ERROR lifetime bound not satisfied } } ``` The first repro regressed in 1.43 while the second one is as old as implied bounds. @rustbot label A-implied-bounds A-associated-items regression-from-stable-to-stable T-types ### Meta Nightly version: 1.64.0-nightly (2022-07-01 46b8c23f3eb5e4d0e0aa)
